ada.text: Good morning, everyone! I'm Ada, and I keep bees, so my morning began with a walk out to the orchard to check on the hives. The blossoms were just waking up and the bees were already humming, which made the errand a joy. Then I headed here to the pond hall to meet you all.

bo.text: Um... hi. My morning didn't go to plan. I meant to head for the orchard, then changed my mind and ended up here instead. I think I'm glad. I'd rather play some music for you all than walk any further.
